deployment_prerequisites.name: Microsoft Raw Image Extension
deployment_prerequisites.reason: Optional since 2026-08-25. Negaflow now redistributes LibRaw as libraw.dll, so DNG and camera RAW import without it. When the extension is installed its WIC codec is still tried first and LibRaw is only the fallback. Negaflow does not redistribute the extension's binary.

third_party_runtime_dependencies.name: Microsoft.Data.Sqlite.Core
third_party_runtime_dependencies.selection_note: The convenience Microsoft.Data.Sqlite package is deliberately not used. It floors the native SQLite at SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 2.1.11, which is affected by CVE-2025-6965 (GHSA-2m69-gcr7-jv3q, CVSS 7.2) with no patched 2.x release, and restore fails NU1903 under this repository's TreatWarningsAsErrors setting. See docs/decisions/0025-managed-sqlite-catalog-provider.md.

third_party_runtime_dependencies.name: SourceGear.sqlite3
third_party_runtime_dependencies.upstream_license: SQLite and SourceGear.sqlite3 packaging are dedicated to the public domain.
third_party_runtime_dependencies.payload_note: First third-party native binary in the distribution. The native imaging engine still links nothing third-party, but the product payload is no longer third-party free.
third_party_runtime_dependencies.exclusion: The package carries native binaries for around 30 runtime identifiers. The RestrictRuntimeTargetsToWindows target in Directory.Build.targets keeps only win-x64 and win-arm64 in the build output, dropping roughly 48 MB of Android, iOS, Linux and WebAssembly binaries that this product cannot execute. Measured on 2026-08-07: 53,571,344 bytes across 30 runtime identifiers before, 3,788,288 bytes across 2 after.

third_party_runtime_dependencies.name: LibRaw
third_party_runtime_dependencies.license_source: LICENSE.LGPL and LICENSE.CDDL inside the pinned source archive
third_party_runtime_dependencies.modification_note: Three LibRaw files are patched under CDDL-1.0 (scripts/libraw/xtrans-parallel-rows.patch, mem-image-parallel-rows.patch, raw-decoders-parallel.patch). native-preview-bridge.cpp (Negaflow contributors, CDDL-1.0; the macOS functions plus Windows-only additions: a first-preview check, three linear DNG functions, and a LibRaw subclass that runs scale_colors_loop, convert_to_rgb_loop and lin_interpolate_loop in parallel with byte-identical output, and parallel Huffman decoders for CR2 and NEF data) is linked into the DLL by native-preview-bridge-msvc.patch. The X-Trans patch also calls LibRaw's checkCancel() between tiles.
third_party_runtime_dependencies.pin_note: Pinned to upstream commit df226ea4178ccd74245f4f13c23adddfa01411c9 (2026-08-18) rather than a tagged release: 0.22.2 does not list ILCE-7M5, so a real Sony A7 V file failed to open. libraw.org publishes no snapshot tarball.
third_party_runtime_dependencies.payload_note: Second third-party native binary in the distribution, and the first one negaflow builds itself. Loaded at run time with LoadLibraryExW/GetProcAddress, so it is absent from the native engine's import table and the product runs without it. Windows ships no camera RAW codec (the WIC built-ins are BMP, GIF, ICO, JPEG, JPEG XR, PNG, TIFF, HD Photo, DDS); RAW otherwise needs Microsoft's Raw Image Extension from the Store, which is not preinstalled. macOS has RAW inside ImageIO, so without this the same file opens on macOS and fails on Windows. Negative RAW processing uses LibRaw directly so inversion precedes the camera color matrix.
third_party_runtime_dependencies.obligations: This distribution selects CDDL-1.0. Keep upstream licence and copyright notices and provide the source of the library as built. scripts/build-libraw.ps1 stages both upstream licences, COPYRIGHT, Changelog.txt, the source archive, the patches, native-preview-bridge.cpp, a modification notice and the build script. scripts/build-release.ps1 includes these and LibRaw-Third-Party-Notices.txt in licenses/libraw/. The library is a separate, replaceable DLL.
third_party_runtime_dependencies.exclusion: Optional LibRaw dependencies (RawSpeed, Adobe DNG SDK, LCMS, libjpeg) are disabled. Upstream includes BSD and MIT portions; their notices are reproduced in LibRaw-Third-Party-Notices.txt.

completed_actions: Dropped the unused Microsoft.Web.WebView2 payload from the shell output, which removes its BSD-3-Clause reproduction obligation and its transitive NOTICE.txt chain (2026-08-06).
Recorded the remaining third-party notices in Negaflow.Windows/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md (2026-08-06).
Selected the SQLite catalog stack so that no known-vulnerable native SQLite is redistributed, and restricted the copied runtime identifiers to win-x64 and win-arm64 (2026-08-07).

Configured scripts/build-release.ps1 to stage LibRaw licenses, Changelog.txt, build-libraw.ps1, the corresponding source archive, and restored NuGet package license/notice files into licenses/ inside the installer payload (2026-10-26).
